name: agent-team
description: An all-in-one pane: the main Claude and its agents as pixel sprites, usage limits (5 h with its projection, weekly, context), per-role token spend, installs and builds, skill packs and loose skills kept per project, the repository's GitHub state, in tabs; plus the four team agents (explorer, implementer, tester, reviewer) with project context in every brief.

teamName.title: Team name
teamName.description: Shown in the pane's title as "<NAME> TEAM". Empty: AGENT TEAM.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto, en or es. auto: Spanish when the system language is Spanish, English otherwise.

updateCheck.title: Check for updates
updateCheck.description: Once a day, ask GitHub whether a newer agent-team release exists and say so in the pane. Turn off to never ask.

sessionLog.title: Session log
sessionLog.description: When a session that used the team ends, write a summary of its agents to a file of its own in agent-team/runs/ in the Claude config folder. Turn off to write nothing.
